::: {.stats-block}
My first-author research has been featured by **342 news outlets** in 19+ languages, discussed in **622 social media posts**, included in **19 blogs**, and covered in **8 podcasts** *(Altmetric, May 2026)*. Highlights include BBC News, Sky News, The Guardian, The Wall Street Journal, The Times, National Geographic, and Scientific American.
:::
